comments.content: Making `content` optional allows `Message.content()` to be null, but `Message#writeTo` and its `StreamInput` constructor still use the non-optional named-writeable methods for this field. Such a request will fail when it is serialized over transport. Please update the wire serialization/deserialization to handle optional content as well (with any required transport-version handling).
